# lol.trq.alts

> A consumer-agnostic Minecraft account-manager core for Fabric mods: Microsoft, OAuth refresh-token, cookie-text, cookie-file, session, and offline login, with silent renewal of a stored session from its refresh token; an encrypted local account store; async player-head and server-agnostic game-stats caches; a zero-knowledge shared alt vault; and a clean set of host SPI seams. Pure JDK plus Gson, with no Minecraft or renderer types of its own.

The library is host-agnostic. A consuming mod supplies a handful of backend seams (session injection, storage directory, texture upload, main-thread executor, toasts, an optional stats source, an optional vault transport resolver, and an optional Microsoft auth config) and wires one `AltsRuntime`. Building the runtime validates the required seams, binds the static stores, and loads them from disk, so `AltStore.accounts()` is populated as soon as it returns. Microsoft login takes the host's own Azure client id; the library ships no default, and `MicrosoftAuthConfig.legacyMsa` speaks the pre-Azure MSA dialect for hosts holding a credential minted by one of those applications.

Two surfaces sit on the same machinery. `AltAccountService` (`check`, `refresh`) validates and renews a stored account **without installing a session**, so a sweep over every alt a host holds does not switch session once per account; `check` is the read-only one, and it is the one to reach for when only looking, because the token endpoint rotates the refresh token on every redemption. `AltLoginService.loginAccount` is `refresh` plus the injection. Requests leave through `HttpUtil` and nowhere else, so a host can install a `ProxyProvider` and route each one by its `NetworkScope` — proxy resolution fails closed, meaning a provider that throws or names no route fails the request rather than disclosing the machine's own address.

`AltLoginService` is the whole login surface: six routes (`loginMicrosoft`, `loginRefreshToken`, `loginCookie`, `loginCookieFile`, `loginSession`, `loginOffline`) plus `loginAccount`, which reuses a stored session while it is live and otherwise renews it from the account's refresh token without a browser round. Every outcome carries a typed `AltLoginCallback.FailureReason`, so a host branches on the cause rather than on a message string; a refused credential and an unreachable service are always classified apart, because one calls for a fresh login and the other for a retry. The shared vault implements the Alt Vault Protocol (AVP), so repositories can be shared across clients; a refresh token is withheld from a repository unless its manifest opts in, because it grants durable account access rather than the day an access token buys.

Notes for implementers: the library never imports a host type, and it must never name a specific consuming mod, client, product, or sponsor in source, docs, tests, or commits. DTOs are Java records with a `@SerializedName` on every component so serialization survives obfuscation, and the ones that carry credentials override `toString` to redact them — keep that when touching them. An encrypted store file that exists but cannot be read is never treated as an empty store: the failure is reported on `loadError()` and the file is copied aside rather than overwritten. House style is palantir-java-format (4-space, 120 column); run `./gradlew spotlessApply` before committing and `./gradlew check` to gate. Every Java snippet in the getting-started guide is inlined from a compiled example, so change the example first and the guide second.

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/README.md): Overview, features, and quick start.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Layers, key pieces, threading, and the vault and federation packages.
- [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md): Wiring the seams, every login route, and the sharing policy.
- [Agent guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/CLAUDE.md): The mental model, the patterns that matter, and the pitfalls, written for coding agents.
- [Examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/examples/README.md): The compiled samples the guide inlines from.
- [Refresh-token design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/docs/specs/2026-07-28-refresh-token-auth.md): Why renewal, the sharing policy, and the typed failure reason are shaped the way they are.
- [Alt-management surface design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/docs/specs/2026-08-05-alt-management-surface.md): Proposed — per-account proxies, operating on an account without logging into it, current identity and UUID-keyed avatars, entitlement as an outcome, bulk operations, and device-code login.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release history.

## Core source

- [AltsRuntime](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/AltsRuntime.java): The wiring root and its builder; the one object a host constructs.
- [AltLoginService](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/AltLoginService.java): The login interface every route lives on.
- [AltLoginServiceImpl](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/AltLoginServiceImpl.java): How each route resolves, renews, and classifies its outcome.
- [AltLoginCallback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/AltLoginCallback.java): `LoginResult` and the typed `FailureReason` a host branches on.
- [AltAccountService](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/AltAccountService.java): Checking and renewing a stored account without logging into it.
- [AccountStatus](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/AccountStatus.java): What an account is worth right now, as a state a host can branch on.
- [ProxyProvider](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/spi/ProxyProvider.java): The per-request routing seam, and why it fails closed.
- [HttpUtil](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/net/HttpUtil.java): The one way out of the library — timeouts, redirect policy, proxy routing.
- [MicrosoftAuthConfig](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/MicrosoftAuthConfig.java): Host-supplied client id, endpoints, and the OAuth vs legacy-MSA dialect.
- [CookieFile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/auth/CookieFile.java): Reading an exported cookie file, byte-order-mark aware and size-capped.
- [AltAccount](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/model/AltAccount.java): The stored account record, its copy methods, and its redacting `toString`.
- [AltStore](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/store/AltStore.java): The encrypted account file, its mutators, and its unreadable-file handling.
- [AsyncCache](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/cache/AsyncCache.java): The lazy, non-blocking, stale-while-revalidate primitive behind both caches.
- [SharedVault](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/lol.trq.alts/main/src/main/java/lol/trq/alts/vault/SharedVault.java): The transport-free crypto facade for a shared repository.

## Protocol

- [Alt Vault Protocol (AVP)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trqlmao/avp/main/SPEC.md): The vendor-neutral wire standard this library's shared vault implements.
